item.title: Glenwood Caverns Adventure Park files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
item.description: Glenwood Caverns Adventure Park has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy just a few months after a jury awarded a family $205 million in a wrongful death lawsuit.

item.title: Yvonne 'Missy' Woods pleads not guilty to mishandling DNA evidence
item.description: Yvonne 'Missy' Woods, a former Colorado Bureau of Investigation DNA analyst, has pleaded not guilty to charges related to her alleged mishandling of evidence in over 1,000 cases.

item.title: Marijuana use, texting, speeding confirmed in crash that killed Kaylee Russell: CSP
item.description: The Colorado State Patrol confirmed that Kaylee Russell had used marijuana before a crash that killed her in November 2025, and she was texting while driving and was driving more than double the suggested speed at the curve where she crashed.
